problem:
$$
|\begin{aligned}4 & 2 & 4 & 3 \\ 2 & 1 & -2 & 5 \\ 3 & 5 & 8 & 6 \\ 4 & 3 & 2 & 5\end{aligned}|
$$

Consider the above $4\times 4$ determinant. Which of the following $3\times 3$ determinants has the same value?

*Hint: Use elementary row operations to make the entries above and below ${a}_{23}$ equal to zero.*

activity_context.topic_title: Finding Determinants Using Row and Column Operations

feedback.problem:
$$
|\begin{aligned}2 & -2 & -3 & 3 \\ -3 & -4 & -2 & 12 \\ -7 & 2 & 3 & -6 \\ 1 & 3 & -2 & -3\end{aligned}|
$$

Consider the above $4\times 4$ determinant. Which of the following $3\times 3$ determinants has the same value?

*Hint: Use elementary row operations to make the entries below ${a}_{14}$ equal to zero.*
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's make entries below ${a}_{14}=3$ equal to zero using elementary row operations.

Since adding a multiple of one row (or column) to another row (column) in a matrix does not change the value of its determinant, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,|\begin{aligned}2 & -2 & -3 & 3 \\ -3 & -4 & -2 & 12 \\ -7 & 2 & 3 & -6 \\ 1 & 3 & -2 & -3\end{aligned}| &  & \,\begin{aligned}{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+(-4){R}_{1} \\ {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+2{R}_{1} \\ {R}_{4}:={R}_{4}+{R}_{1}\end{aligned} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}2 & -2 & -3 & 3 \\ -11 & 4 & 10 & 0 \\ -3 & -2 & -3 & 0 \\ 3 & 1 & -5 & 0\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the result along the $4$th column, we get

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,|\begin{aligned}2 & -2 & -3 & 3 \\ -11 & 4 & 10 & 0 \\ -3 & -2 & -3 & 0 \\ 3 & 1 & -5 & 0\end{aligned}| \\  & =3\cdot (-1)^{1+4}|\begin{aligned}-11 & 4 & 10 \\ -3 & -2 & -3 \\ 3 & 1 & -5\end{aligned}| \\  & =-3|\begin{aligned}-11 & 4 & 10 \\ -3 & -2 & -3 \\ 3 & 1 & -5\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$
